items.source: This method allows setting all XADD options at once, including trimming strategies (MAXLEN, MINID), stream creation behavior (NOMKSTREAM), and other parameters. Constructs a new command instance with all previously configured properties except the options, which are replaced by the provided RedisStreamCommands.XAddOptions.
items.translation: 此方法允许一次性设置所有 XADD 选项，包括修剪策略（MAXLEN、MINID）、流创建行为（NOMKSTREAM）以及其他参数。该方法会构建一个新的命令实例，其中包含所有先前配置的属性，但会用提供的RedisStreamCommands.XAddOptions替换选项部分。
